examples.text: Children may not be stashing coins in piggy banks（bank的复数形式）（储钱罐）for much longer.
examples.translation: 孩子们把硬币存进存钱罐的做法，可能不会再持续太久了。
examples.speechText: Children may not be stashing coins in piggy banksfor much longer.

examples.text: Convenience foods from the supermarket simplify shopping and cooking（cook的-ing形式）.
examples.translation: 超市里的方便食品让购物和做饭变得更简单。
examples.speechText: Convenience foods from the supermarket simplify shopping and cooking.

examples.text: The earlier you start the quitting process, the more smoke-free years you can invest in your happiness account.
examples.translation: 越早开始戒烟，你就能把越多无烟的岁月存入自己的“幸福账户”。
examples.speechText: The earlier you start the quitting process, the more smoke-free years you can invest in your happiness account.

examples.text: These factors give coastal deserts unique features that are not found in other deserts.
examples.translation: 这些因素赋予沿海沙漠一些其他沙漠所没有的独特特征。
examples.speechText: These factors give coastal deserts unique features that are not found in other deserts.

examples.text: You can practice self-talk, build confidence, and focus on self-development.
examples.translation: 你可以练习与自己对话，建立信心，并专注于自我发展。
examples.speechText: You can practice self-talk, build confidence, and focus on self-development.

examples.text: The only thing now standing in the way of further progress is lack of money.
examples.translation: 现在，阻碍进一步发展的唯一因素是缺少资金。
examples.speechText: The only thing now standing in the way of further progress is lack of money.

examples.text: The reality is that writing is a lonely, private and poor-paying affair.
examples.translation: 现实是，写作是一件孤独、私密而且收入微薄的事情。
examples.speechText: The reality is that writing is a lonely, private and poor-paying affair.

examples.text: He shares his affection regularly, clinging to everyone's side—even the dogs!
examples.translation: 他经常分享他的情感，依附在每个人的身边，甚至连狗也不例外！
examples.speechText: He shares his affection regularly, clinging to everyone's side—even the dogs!

examples.text: Don’t use a friend’s tragedy as an excuse to drag out similar experiences you’ve had.
examples.translation: 不要拿朋友的不幸作为借口，扯出你自己过去的类似经历。
examples.speechText: Don’t use a friend’s tragedy as an excuse to drag out similar experiences you’ve had.

examples.text: Avoid the troublesome search for clean clothes by laying（lay的-ing形式） them out the night before.
examples.translation: 前一天晚上就把干净衣服放置好，以免第二天费力寻找。
examples.speechText: Avoid the troublesome search for clean clothes by laying them out the night before.

examples.text: Indeed, the health benefits of jumping rope are many and affect multiple systems throughout the body.
examples.translation: 确实，跳绳对健康有许多好处，并会影响全身多个系统。
examples.speechText: Indeed, the health benefits of jumping rope are many and affect multiple systems throughout the body.

examples.text: As you improve, you may add no more than 10% additional volume per week.
examples.translation: 随着水平提高，每周增加的训练量不应超过10%。
examples.speechText: As you improve, you may add no more than 10% additional volume per week.

examples.text: You just need to increase the pot size by 2 inches and water it two days before repotting so that the soil becomes loose and it’s ready for the process.
examples.translation: 你只需要换一个大两英寸的花盆，并在换盆前两天浇水，让土壤变松，为换盆做好准备。
examples.speechText: You just need to increase the pot size by 2 inches and water it two days before repotting so that the soil becomes loose and it’s ready for the process.

examples.text: Human drivers at rush hour, however, are hardly willing to follow such rules.
examples.translation: 然而，高峰时段的人类司机几乎不愿遵守这样的规则。
examples.speechText: Human drivers at rush hour, however, are hardly willing to follow such rules.

examples.text: The simplest solution is the use of programs which block offensive sites.
examples.translation: 最简单的解决办法，是使用能够屏蔽不良网站的程序。
examples.speechText: The simplest solution is the use of programs which block offensive sites.
